main_text.l: in Sylvium atque adversus bilem ex-
verba ejus sic sonant: Bilis vero flava,
quæ circa hepar versatur, corpori est
exitio ubi ebullit. Est enim corpori
sed primo nihil tale loco à Le Vas-
men illi hunc lapsum, secutus enim
hoc loco aravit. Sed quæso, licet hæc
inferri posset? non enim ibi statuitur
bilem semper esse corpori exitio, sed
videlicet sese habens, adeo ut Le Vas-

l.i: liter se se habente, quam nocere Sylvius
centies monet, eique in praxi suâ

page.notes: Scan is slightly skewed; some words in the lower lines are partly obscured. Transcription is from the printed text; the final line "Pari" is a catchword. Lines 24 to 25 are italic and were treated as one passage.
